summaryFa: دوست، پژمردگی را درست می‌بیند اما پیشنهاد آب بیشتر برای گیاهی که در آب مانده درست نیست.
storyFa: در قاب راست آدمک بنفش پژمردگی گلدان را می‌بیند و آب بیشتر پیشنهاد می‌کند. صاحب صورتی علامت را می‌پذیرد؛ سپس گلدان داخلی را بالا می‌آورد و آب جمع‌شدهٔ ظرف بیرونی علت واقعی را نشان می‌دهد.
meaningFa: بازخوردِ تجربه‌شده را جدی بگیر؛ اما پیش از اجرای نسخهٔ پیشنهادی، علت را بررسی کن. گاهی همان درمان پیشنهادی مشکل را بدتر می‌کند.
fullGenerationPromptEnglish:
Use case: illustration-story. One NEW square adult Persian visual-book watercolor comic, TWO panels read RIGHT TO LEFT. Image 1 is the approved adult body/watercolor reference, image 2 the approved glints, cheeks and subtle lashes reference. No copying their stories.
MEANING: Someone is accurately noticing the symptom, but their suggested cure may be the very thing making it worse. Listen sincerely to the observation, investigate the cause, and do not blindly accept the prescription.
RIGHT PANEL: In a simple bright home conservatory, a coral-pink adult with two fine upper-outer lashes has a potted leafy houseplant whose leaves are obviously limp and drooping. The simple terracotta INNER POT sits inside a deep blue waterproof decorative OUTER POT. Visible dark wet soil and one small water puddle indicate overwatering, without labels. The violet visiting adult points kindly at the wilted leaves and holds a full small watering can, NOT yet pouring. One bubble from violet reads exactly "پژمرده‌ست؛ بیشتر آب بده!" Pink looks at the very same leaves, nods thoughtfully, and answers in a small bubble exactly "پژمرده‌ست، درست می‌گی." Expressions are concerned, not argumentative.
LEFT PANEL: The SAME pink owner has lifted the SAME terracotta inner pot out of the SAME deep blue decorative outer pot. The blue outer pot is almost full of trapped water, clearly visible to us from a slightly elevated view; a little water drains out of the terracotta pot's drainage hole above it. Pink holds the pot with TWO coherent supporting hands, enough scale for readable fingers, and looks into the trapped water with a small realizing smile. The violet friend has lowered the unused watering can and looks with interest at the trapped water. Pink says exactly "از زیادیِ آب بود!" The plant is still somewhat drooping: it has not magically recovered in seconds. The visual payoff is that pouring in more water would worsen the actual problem; accepting the correct report led to a different solution. No plant uprooting, floating roots, toxic bottle, dead plant, ridicule, long moral caption or extra objects.
ART DIRECTION AND CHARACTER INVARIANTS: Match the attached approved book illustrations ONLY for character design and authentic restrained hand-painted watercolor, not their settings. Softly irregular broad overlapping transparent washes INSIDE the head, torso, arms, legs and hands, varying pigment density and subtle pooling, luminous paper; moderate watercolor strength. No colored-pencil or marker grain, no flat vector, no glossy 3D, no uniform embossed/crystalline texture. Contours are a darker shade of each character's own body color, not black. Every head is a simple true circle of equal width and height, never oval, no flattened chin, no ears/hair/nose. Head joins torso directly with NO NECK and a soft crescent of deeper local color under the head. Moderately built ADULT bodies exactly like the approved references: not chubby, not skinny, no bulging arms, no chibi. All bodies have the same simple neutral torso and pelvis, absolutely no breasts/bust, protruding buttocks, broad hips, pinched waist or gendered bulges. Female cue only two tiny fine upper-outer eyelashes on otherwise IDENTICAL small dark vertical oval eyes. Each dark eye MUST have one tiny reflected white glint INSIDE its dark shape; never white sclera around a pupil, never human eyeballs or frightening blank black eyes. Add subtle translucent diffuse rosy cheeks with soft watercolor edges, never flat pink discs. Minimal expressive brows and mouth. Exactly THREE fingers and ONE thumb on each visible hand (four digits total); anatomically coherent grips and limbs. No unmotivated selective clothing; aprons only if the occupation needs them. Identity and body color stay consistent in every panel.
COMPOSITION AND READABILITY: One complete square image, spacious book illustration with a clear cause and effect narrative. All full bodies, feet, hands and important objects stay completely inside the painting, never cropped at the bottom. Clean white outer paper margin, paint not touching file edges; vary natural airy watercolor vignette edges using a simple background ending naturally, no heavy black panel frames. Thin white gutters between panels. Horizontal sequences read RIGHT TO LEFT and vertical sequence TOP TO BOTTOM. Short accurate connected Persian RTL text only as specified, no English, no watermark, no captions explaining the moral. Bubble tails must point to the correct speaker. Purposeful sparse adult everyday setting, warm kind mood and gentle human wit. Every gaze, pointing hand and action must target its actual object; match perspective, physical contact and object continuity.

notesFa: تصویر واقعی با view_image دیده شد؛ هر سه حباب فارسی درست و خوانا هستند.
گلدان و رنگ شخصیت‌ها در دو قاب ثابت‌اند، آبِ جمع‌شده و زهکشی در قاب دوم خواناست، گیاه ناگهان سالم نشده است.
چشم‌ها برق کوچک داخلی دارند و صورتی فقط با مژه مشخص می‌شود؛ بدن‌ها خنثی و تمام پاها داخل کادرند.
بخشی از انگشت‌های درگیر گرفتن گلدان از دید پوشیده‌اند و شمارش مستقل همهٔ آن‌ها ممکن نیست.
qa.limitations: Occluded fingers cannot be independently counted. This is a candidate awaiting user review, not an approval.

framingCorrectionInstruction: Preserve the story, plant and text; pull back only the right panel enough to show the entire purple figure and both feet within clean white margins.

rootVisualReview.observations: Actual final reframed right panel now fully contains the purple figure and both feet. Same wilted plant stays wilted; pooled water and draining pot show that more water was the wrong remedy. Pink has subtle lashes and both figures retain neutral bodies and eye glints.
